parts.name: shell dome

physics.Basic_description: Large red spherical shell with a smooth, matte finish forming the main protective body of the helmet.
physics.Functional_description: Primary impact protection structure enclosing the head cavity.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the top or side curvature with a parallel jaw gripper, ensuring broad contact to distribute force on the curved surface.
physics.reason: Helmet shells are thin-walled composite structures enclosing air/foam; treating as solid would vastly overestimate mass.

parts.description: Large red spherical shell with a smooth, matte finish forming the main protective body of the helmet.
parts.function: Primary impact protection structure enclosing the head cavity.

parts.name: face rim

physics.Basic_description: Black flexible trim lining the face opening, appearing soft and matte.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a seal against the face and cushions the edge of the shell opening.
physics.Grasped_description: Too flexible and thin to grasp reliably for lifting; would deform under grip force.
physics.reason: Rubber trim is a solid extrusion or molded strip, though thin, it is not a hollow container.

parts.description: Black flexible trim lining the face opening, appearing soft and matte.

parts.name: vent 0

physics.Basic_description: Small dark blue/black rectangular inserts located on the top and front of the shell.
physics.Functional_description: Allow airflow into the helmet interior for cooling.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and flush with the surface to be grasped effectively.
physics.reason: Small injection molded plastic components, effectively solid relative to their size.

parts.name: pivot stud left

physics.Basic_description: Small orange circular stud on the side of the helmet near the visor hinge.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a pivot point or cover for the visor rotation mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small to grasp; would slip or damage the mechanism.
physics.reason: Small mechanical fastener or cap, effectively solid.

parts.name: visor panel

physics.Basic_description: Large cyan-tinted transparent curved shield covering the face opening.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the eyes and face from wind, debris, and impacts while maintaining visibility.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the bottom edge or side corner gently to avoid scratching the optical surface.
physics.reason: Visors are thin sheets of polycarbonate; the bounding volume is mostly air.

parts.description: Large cyan-tinted transparent curved shield covering the face opening.
parts.function: Protects the eyes and face from wind, debris, and impacts while maintaining visibility.

parts.name: visor trim

physics.Basic_description: Magenta strip running along the edge of the visor panel.
physics.Functional_description: Seals the gap between the visor and the shell to prevent drafts and noise.
physics.Grasped_description: Flexible strip attached to the visor; grasping it might detach or deform it.
physics.reason: Rubber seal is a solid strip of material.

parts.description: Magenta strip running along the edge of the visor panel.
parts.function: Seals the gap between the visor and the shell to prevent drafts and noise.

parts.name: visor pivot arms

physics.Basic_description: Pink structural arms connecting the visor to the helmet shell at the pivot points.
physics.Functional_description: Mechanical linkage allowing the visor to rotate up and down.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped to manipulate the visor position, but care must be taken not to stress the pivot.
physics.reason: Structural linkage arms are typically solid or thick-walled injection molded parts.

parts.description: Pink structural arms connecting the visor to the helmet shell at the pivot points.
parts.function: Mechanical linkage allowing the visor to rotate up and down.

parts.name: visor axle

physics.Basic_description: Small lime green cylindrical pin at the center of the visor pivot mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: The central axis around which the visor rotates.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and recessed to grasp.
physics.reason: Metal axle pin is a solid cylinder.

parts.description: Small lime green cylindrical pin at the center of the visor pivot mechanism.
parts.function: The central axis around which the visor rotates.

parts.name: sun visor panel

physics.Basic_description: Dark teal tinted shield visible inside the helmet behind the main visor.
physics.Functional_description: Internal drop-down shield to reduce glare from sunlight.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the bottom edge of the internal shield to deploy or retract it.
physics.reason: Internal sun visor is a thin sheet of plastic, similar to the main visor.

parts.description: Dark teal tinted shield visible inside the helmet behind the main visor.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
